<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex22042024-10-1809-29-13" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"> 
         <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (97a5)"/>
            <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4635"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3746">theg pa chen po'i mdo' sde'i rgyan</rs> gyi dka' ba'i <lb n="97a6"/> gnas bshad ba</rs> | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3916">shag kya'i dge' slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan<anchor xml:id="a2"/></rs><note type="editorial">According to the KDSB dkar chag this is lHa ston Zhig po bSod nams rgyal mtshan (ID:6352), the 20th abbot of gSang phu (he is the 13th abbot of gSang phu gling sTod according to Onoda 1989: 211). The BDRC however connects this text with Bla ma Dam pa bSod nams rgyal mtshan P1226 (1327-1344) (ID:3916).</note> gyis sbyar ba | rdzogs s+ho ||</seg></TEI>
source: 1_022_04 Theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan gyi dka gnad bshad pa.xml
